name: lifesynch-ai
description: LifeSynch AI - AI-powered personal digital life management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan.bold,magenta.bold" "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.check-types: npm run check-types -w shared && npm run check-types -w backend && npm run check-types -w frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w backend && npm run lint -w frontend

author: LifeSynch AI Team
